title: Implement clean, natural agent loop termination upon stage transition (advance_task, move_task, reject_task)
commitMessage: feat(agent): natural loop exit on stage transition (advance_task, move_task, reject_task)
author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer)
summary: Implemented clean, natural ReAct loop termination in run_agent_loop upon execution of stage transition tools (advance_task, move_task, reject_task). When any transition tool is executed, the agent has handed over or finalized the task; the engine records the tool response in message history, syncs state to AppState, emits AgentEvent::Finished { final_response }, and immediately breaks the loop returning Ok(result_str). Under no circumstances is the result sent back to the LLM for an extra turn.

rootCauses.cause: Extra ReAct Loop Turn after Stage Handover
rootCauses.detail: When an agent invoked advance_task, move_task, or reject_task, the tool execution moved the task card, but the agent loop appended tool_response and continued to turn N+1, sending the result back to the LLM for an unnecessary redundant turn.
rootCauses.resolution: Intercepted stage transition tools in run_agent_loop, emitting AgentEvent::Finished and breaking the loop immediately with Ok(result_str).
